custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_start_Wardcraft
	tooltip = DA_PR_tt.Wardcraft
	potential = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_selected value = 38 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress } }
	trigger = {
		DA_available_research = yes
		DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
		DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_SM_req_abjuration_1_tt OR = { is_overall_abjuration_level_1_minimum = yes has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Abjuration.1 has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Abjuration.2 has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Abjuration.3 } }
		DA_PR_todo.Wardcraft = yes
	}
	effect = {
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_Wardcraft
			time = 48
			arcane = yes
			unstoppable = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 38 } } set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 } } }
	}
}

	tooltip = DA_PR_tt.KB_Scales_Blood2
	potential = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_selected value = 175 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress } }
	trigger = {
		DA_available_research = yes
		DA_PR_done.KB_Scales_Blood1 = yes
		DA_PR_done.KB_LifeBrick = yes
		DA_KB_path_open.Scales_Blood = yes
		DA_KB_not_critical = yes
		DA_KB_price.KB_Scales_Blood2 = yes
		DA_PR_todo.KB_Scales_Blood2 = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { DA_KB_council_disc.Scales_Blood = yes }
			add_treasury = -300
			custom_tooltip = DA_KB_pay_tt.KB_Scales_Blood2.council
			hidden_effect = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = -9 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -4 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Scales_Blood = yes } DA_KB_aspect_disc.Scales_Blood = yes }
			add_treasury = -360
			custom_tooltip = DA_KB_pay_tt.KB_Scales_Blood2.aspect
			hidden_effect = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = -11 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -5 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Scales_Blood = yes } NOT = { DA_KB_aspect_disc.Scales_Blood = yes } }
			add_treasury = -400
			custom_tooltip = DA_KB_pay_tt.KB_Scales_Blood2.full
			hidden_effect = {
				change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = -12 }
				change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -5 }
			}
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_KB_Scales_Blood2
			time = 72
			arcane = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 175 } } set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 } } }
	}
}

	}

		}

# ---- Research queue ----
custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_queue_button
	tooltip = DA_PR_queue_button_tt
	potential = { has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress check_variable = { which = DA_PR_selected value = 1 } }
	trigger = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_PR_queue_open_tt DA_PR_selected_is_open = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_PR_queue_not_queued_tt NOT = { DA_PR_selected_is_queued = yes } }
	}
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = DA_PR_queue_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued which = DA_PR_selected } }
	}
}
custom_text_box = {
	name = DA_PR_queued_name
	tooltip = DA_PR_queued_name_tt
	potential = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }
}
custom_button = {
	name = DA_PR_queue_clear
	tooltip = DA_PR_queue_clear_tt
	potential = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }
	effect = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 } } }
}
